theorem lg_target (x : ℝ) {t p : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (ht : t ≠ 0) : |x| ^ p ≤ (p / |t|) ^ p * max (Real.exp (t * x)) (Real.exp (-t * x)) := by
  have h_max : max (Real.exp (t * x)) (Real.exp (-t * x)) = Real.exp (|t| * |x|) := by
    rw [Real.max_eq]
    rcases eq_or_lt_zero t with (h1|h2)
    · contradiction ht h1
    · have h3 : t < 0 := neg_pos_iff_neg.mp h2
      have h4 : -t > 0 := pos_neg.mpr h3
      have h5 : |t| = -t := abs_neg.mp h3
      have h6 : |t| * |x| = -t * |x| := by rw [h5]
      have h7 : Real.exp (t * x) ≤ Real.exp (|t| * |x|) :=
        by rw [Real.exp_le_exp]; exact le_abs_self _
      have h8 : Real.exp (-t * x) ≤ Real.exp (|t| * |x|) :=
        by rw [Real.exp_le_exp]; exact le_abs_self _
      exact eq_of_le_of_ge h7 h8
  rw [h_max]
  have h_pow : |x|^p ≤ (p / |t|)^p * Real.exp (|t| * |x|) := by
    apply Real.le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    · exact (Real.pow_pos (le_rfl (le_refl p)) (le_rfl (le_refl |t|))).symm
    · exact Real.exp_nonneg _
    · exact Real.le_pow_exp <| by { rw [Real.abs_mul, Real.abs_pos], exact mul_nonneg (le_rfl (le_refl p)) (le_rfl (le_refl |t|)) }
  exact h_pow
